20261118-math-g01.title: Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo
20261118-math-g01.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261118-math-g01.material: [E1 Uphando Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophando malunga ne-Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo. Amanani emvelo amabini u-$A$ no-$B$ anelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Xa u-$A$ ethatha elona nani likhulu linokwenzeka, liyintoni ixabiso lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Uphando Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophando malunga ne-Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo. Amanani emvelo amabini u-$A$ no-$B$ anelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Xa u-$A$ ethatha elona nani likhulu linokwenzeka, liyintoni ixabiso lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukulungelelanisa isibalo kunika u-$A = 24 - 2B$.
Inyathelo 2: Njengoko u-$A, B \ge 1$ ingamanani emvelo, u-$2B$ kufuneka abe mncinci kangangoko ukuze u-$A$ abe mkhulu.
Inyathelo 3: Elona nani lemvelo lincinci ngu-$B = 1$.
Inyathelo 4: Kweli nqanaba, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ubukhulu), ngoko ke $B = 1$.
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.hint.0: Elona nani lincinci lemvelo lika-$B$ ngu-$1$.
20261118-math-g01.s.s1.hint.1: Kuba $A = 24 - 2B$, u-$A$ uba mkhulu xa u-$B$ emncinci.

20261119-math-g01-2.material: [E1 Uphando Lwezibalo (Phambili)] Ingxaki yophando entsonkothileyo usebenzisa i-Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo. Isiphumo sokudityaniswa kwamanani emvelo amathathu alandelelanayo ngu-$3S$, kwaye isiphumo sokuphinda-phinda elona lincinci nelona likhulu xa udibanise no-$1$ silingana no-$T^2$. Xa u-$S = 15$, leliphi elona nani likhulu kula mathathu?
20261119-math-g01-2.s.s1.prompt: [E1 Uphando Lwezibalo (Phambili)] Ingxaki yophando entsonkothileyo usebenzisa i-Amanani nemisebenzi, iimilo. Xa u-$S = 15$, leliphi elona nani likhulu kula mathathu?
20261119-math-g01-2.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukuthatha amanani njengo-$n-1, n, n+1$, isiphumo siba ngu-$3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.
Inyathelo 2: Amanani amathathu ngu-$14, 15, 16$.
Inyathelo 3: Elona nani likhulu ngu-$16$.
Inyathelo 4: Ukuqinisekisa: $(14 \times 16) + 1 = 224 + 1 = 225 = 15^2$.

Isiphumo sokudityaniswa kwamanani emvelo amathathu alandelelanayo ngu-$3S$, kwaye isiphumo sokuphinda-phinda elona lincinci nelona likhulu xa udibanise no-$1$ silingana no-$T^2$. Xa u-$S = 15$, leliphi elona nani likhulu kula mathathu?

Xa u-$S = 15$, leliphi elona nani likhulu kula mathathu?
20261125-math-g01-2.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukuthatha amanani njengo-$n-1, n, n+1$, isiphumo siba ngu-$3n = 3S \Rightarrow n = S = 15$.

20261118-math-g02.title: Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda
20261118-math-g02.topic: Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda
20261118-math-g02.goal: Sebenzisa imigaqo ye-Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda ukusombulula ingxaki yophando.
20261118-math-g02.material: [E2 Uphando Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophando malunga ne-Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda. Amanani emvelo amabini u-$A$ no-$B$ anelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Xa u-$A$ ethatha elona nani likhulu linokwenzeka, liyintoni ixabiso lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g02.thinking.0: Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda
20261118-math-g02.s.s1.prompt: [E2 Uphando Lwezibalo] Umbuzo wophando malunga ne-Ixabiso lendawo, ukudibanisa nokususa, ukuqala kokuphindaphinda. Amanani emvelo amabini u-$A$ no-$B$ anelisa $A + 2B = 24$. Xa u-$A$ ethatha elona nani likhulu linokwenzeka, liyintoni ixabiso lika-$B$?
20261118-math-g02.s.s1.explain:
Inyathelo 1: Ukulungelelanisa isibalo kunika u-$A = 24 - 2B$.
Inyathelo 2: Njengoko u-$A, B \ge 1$ ingamanani emvelo, u-$2B$ kufuneka abe mncinci kangangoko ukuze u-$A$ abe mkhulu.
Inyathelo 3: Elona nani lemvelo lincinci ngu-$B = 1$.
Inyathelo 4: Kweli nqanaba, $A = 24 - 2(1) = 22$ (ubukhulu), ngoko ke $B = 1$.
20261118-math-g02.s.s1.hint.0: Elona nani lincinci lemvelo lika-$B$ ngu-$1$.
20261118-math-g02.s.s1.hint.1: Kuba $A = 24 - 2B$, u-$A$ uba mkhulu xa u-$B$ emncinci.
